outcome_definition: Outcome = the smallest initial DNA input (ng, fluorimetric) at which the named genotype was still correctly identified by the named method. This is an INPUT amount, not a variant allele fraction: it says nothing about detecting a minority allele in a mixture. Rows 0.1 ng and 0.01 ng are failures (no genotype), recorded to bound the series from below.
